summary: In 2026, the enterprise foundation-model access market is dominated by hyperscaler-native platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) that let corporations consume GPT, Claude, Llama, and other models through managed APIs without data leaving their cloud VPC. There is no single winner — the best fit is driven by which cloud a company already runs, its data-residency obligations, and the specific models it needs. Data-gravity platforms like Snowflake Cortex AI and governance-focused studios like IBM watsonx are growing fast where enterprise data and compliance programs already live.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: models run inside the enterprise's existing VPC/cloud region so prompts, documents, and fine-tuning data never leave governed boundaries or cross jurisdictional lines.
Compliance and certifications: platforms inherit the cloud provider's SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and FedRAMP accreditations, satisfying audits without re-certifying each model vendor separately.
Consolidated billing and existing contracts: AI spend flows through committed cloud spend agreements (EDPs/MACC) and a single invoice rather than many separate vendor subscriptions.

Vendor flexibility and reduced lock-in: a unified API lets teams swap or compare multiple frontier and open models without rewriting integrations, hedging against any one provider's pricing or outages.
Operational maturity: built-in IAM, audit logging, private networking, guardrails, RAG, and agent tooling remove the need to build a bespoke platform-engineering layer around raw vendor APIs.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service
available_models: selected Llama and Mistral models (via Azure AI Foundry)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per 1K/1M tokens plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; billed through Azure enterprise agreements.
key_features: Enterprise commercial terms and IP indemnity
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-centric enterprises wanting OpenAI frontier models with strong enterprise terms and FedRAMP.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token plus Provisioned Throughput for committed capacity; batch discounts; billed via AWS accounts.
key_features: Broadest multi-model choice via single API
platforms.best_for: Enterprises with AWS data gravity wanting maximum model choice and strong governance.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token/character plus Provisioned Throughput; committed use discounts; billed via Google Cloud.
key_features: VPC Service Controls and private endpoints
Vertex AI Agent Builder and RAG Engine
Fine-tuning and grounding with Google Search/BigQuery
platforms.best_for: Google-native enterprises and workloads needing long context and tight BigQuery/data integration.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits plus new AI credits (introduced April 1, 2026, priced at $2.00 per credit globally).
key_features: AI runs next to governed data inside Snowflake
No data movement outside the governed estate
platforms.best_for: Enterprises with Snowflake-centered data estates wanting AI directly on governed analytical data.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Capacity Unit (CUH) / token-based consumption pricing; hybrid and on-prem licensing options.
key_features: Integrated governed AI studio (watsonx.ai + watsonx.governance + watsonx.data)
Strong model governance and risk/lifecycle tracking
Open Granite models with IP indemnity
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises needing hybrid deployment, strong governance, and IBM ecosystem fit.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
available_models: selected models via OCI Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-character/token plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity; billed via OCI.
key_features: Tight integration with Oracle Database and Fusion Apps
platforms.best_for: Oracle database and ERP/Fusion-centric enterprises needing AI near Oracle data with sovereign options.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
available_models: embedding and image models (via AI Gateway for proprietary models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per neuron / per-request on Cloudflare's global edge network.
key_features: Serverless inference at the network edge for low latency
AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting, and observability across providers
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency edge inference and multi-provider AI gateway/observability.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.pricing: Unified pay-as-you-go pricing with transparent per-model rates and credit top-ups; no subscription required.
key_features: Single unified API across hundreds of models
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams wanting broad multi-model access and flexible routing via one API, less suited to strict in-VPC residency.
